title: Mystic Eye of Wonder
description: A large stylized human eye with cracked sclera and glowing blue iris dominates the center, held by a green hand with roots. Above it, two puzzle-piece ribbons form eyebrows with a black cat perched on them. The scene is surrounded by glowing flowers, vines, and swirling cosmic patterns against a dark background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy artwork featuring a large cracked white eye with glowing blue iris and yellow inner rings at the center. A green hand with visible roots holds a black and white spotted orb near the pupil. Two white puzzle-piece ribbons with black symbols form the eyebrows. A small black cat with glowing white spots sits atop the ribbons. Surrounded by glowing yellow flowers, green vines, blue energy swirls and roots on a dark background.
